abdm_aadhaar_otp: OTP sent to the Aadhaar-linked mobile
abdm_abha_already_linked: This ABHA is already linked to another patient.
abdm_abha_already_linked_hint: CARE saves this new patient without the ABHA. Open the other patient record to use the ABHA.
abdm_address_hint: 4–32 characters: letters, digits, dot or underscore.
abdm_admin_callbacks_description: The last 20 callbacks the gateway posted to this bridge, with the result of the signature check and how each one was processed.
abdm_admin_facilities_description: Every CARE facility and its ABDM state: the Health Facility Registry link, the HIP and HIU services on this bridge, and the last refused call. Add a facility here, or open one to change its ABDM setup.
abdm_admin_intro: Live view of this CARE instance's ABDM connection: the gateway session, the callback bridge, the registered services, and every facility with its ABDM state.
abdm_admin_no_facilities: No facility in CARE yet. Add the first one; the wizard links it to the registry on the way.
abdm_bridge_description: The bridge is the callback URL for this whole CARE instance. It is 1 per client ID. The values come from the gateway.
abdm_bridge_load_failed: Could not load the ABDM bridge setup.
abdm_bridge_register_failed: Could not register the callback URL.
abdm_bridge_services_description: Each row is a HIP or HIU service the gateway holds under this bridge (gateway-list-bridge-services).
abdm_card_unavailable: The ABHA session has expired. Re-verify via OTP to fetch the card again.
abdm_cc_explainer: Share this visit's records with the patient's ABHA so the patient can see them in their ABHA app.
abdm_cc_no_abha: Link the patient's ABHA on the Demography tab first.
abdm_cc_no_records: A prescription or consultation note is needed before this visit can be shared.
abdm_cc_ready: This visit has not been shared yet.
abdm_cc_share_failed: Could not start sharing. Try again.
abdm_cc_status_facility_not_setup: This facility is not set up for ABDM yet. Open Configurations → ABDM.
abdm_choose_hint: Create a new ABHA with Aadhaar, or link one the patient already has.
abdm_consent_note: The patient consents to share their Aadhaar demographic details with ABDM to create an ABHA, and to link this facility's records to it. Care records this consent.
abdm_counter_code_help: 1 to 20 letters or digits. Examples: OPD1, Pharmacy. Do not use the facility ID, the HIP ID, or the HIP name.
abdm_create_abha_hint: Verify Aadhaar with an OTP and issue a new health account.
abdm_error_generic: Something went wrong while talking to ABDM.
abdm_facility_help_hip_name_how: How to set it: Choose a name patients know. Use 15 characters or fewer. Use no special characters. Keep it unique per bridge on this facility.
abdm_facility_help_hip_name_what: What it is: The patient-visible HIP name for bridge linkage.
abdm_facility_load_failed: Could not load the ABDM facility setup.
abdm_facility_save_failed: Could not save the ABDM facility setup.
abdm_facility_setup_intro: Enter the facility's Health Facility Registry details and register it with ABDM so that records from this facility can be shared with patients' ABHA.
abdm_fetch_action_failed: The action could not be completed.
abdm_fetch_dialog_bad_range: The start date is after the end date.
abdm_fetch_dialog_intro: The patient sees this request in their ABHA app and can change the dates, the record types and the validity before they agree.
abdm_fetch_footer_hint: The patient decides in their ABHA app. This page updates by itself.
abdm_fetch_intro: Ask the patient for permission to read the records other facilities hold against their ABHA address. When the patient agrees in their ABHA app, the records appear here.
abdm_fetch_load_failed: Could not load the requests for this patient.
abdm_fetch_no_callback_url: The ABDM callback URL is not set for this instance. Tell the administrator.
abdm_fetch_no_records_yet: The permission is given. No record has arrived yet. Press Fetch again to ask once more.
abdm_fetch_none: No request yet. Press Request records to ask the patient.
abdm_fetch_provider_failed: The facility search failed. Leave it empty to ask every facility.
abdm_fetch_provider_help: Leave empty to ask every facility the patient has records at.
abdm_fetch_request_failed: The request could not be sent.
abdm_fetch_validity_help: The records are erased from this system when the permission ends.
abdm_fetch_waiting_for_records: The permission is given. The records are on their way.
abdm_hfr_additional_help: Which services the facility runs, and the programme identifiers it already holds.
abdm_hfr_basic_help: Codes come from the registry's own lists. The first save creates the record and returns the tracking ID; later saves update it.
abdm_hfr_dedup_help: Ask the registry for facilities with this name in this sub-district. If yours is listed, link it from the setup page instead of registering it again.
abdm_hfr_dedup_matches: {{count}} facility record(s) match. Compare them before you continue.
abdm_hfr_dedup_none: No match yet. Run the check, or continue if you already know the facility is new.
abdm_hfr_detailed_help: Specialities per system of medicine, and the sections that apply to this facility type.
abdm_hfr_infrastructure_help: Type each count. The total is derived from the 6 bed counts; the registry refuses any other total.
abdm_hfr_intro: Every ABDM record names the facility by its HFR ID. Find this facility in the registry and link it, so the registered name is the one ABDM sees. A facility that is not in the registry yet can be registered from here.
abdm_hfr_link_failed: The facility could not be linked.
abdm_hfr_load_failed: Could not load the registration state.
abdm_hfr_lookup_help: 12 characters, starts with IN. From the NHPR portal or the facility's HFR certificate.
abdm_hfr_multi_hint: Hold Ctrl or Cmd to pick more than 1.
abdm_hfr_not_found: The HFR holds no facility with this ID.
abdm_hfr_otp_help: For a government programme: an OTP goes to the mobile number registered against this facility in the HFR. Enter the programme code (for example AB-PMJAY) and the OTP.
abdm_hfr_otp_title: Verify a programme link by OTP
abdm_hfr_photo_help: PNG or JPEG, up to 5 MB.
abdm_hfr_register_hint: Not in the registry yet? Register the facility from CARE. A facility manager's HPR login is needed.
abdm_hfr_search_failed: The search failed. Try again later.
abdm_hfr_search_label: Or search the registry by name
abdm_hfr_search_more: {{total}} facilities match. Narrow the search with the district or more of the name.
abdm_hfr_session_active: Logged in to the HPR as {{id}}.
abdm_hfr_session_needed: The registry needs a facility manager's HPR login (role 2 or 3) before it saves a facility.
abdm_hfr_session_role_warning: This HPR ID has no facility-manager role. The registry may refuse the facility.
abdm_hfr_source_hint: Only when a programme gave you one, for example HRP_SUB_1.
abdm_hfr_specialities_need_som: Pick a system of medicine in the basic information first.
abdm_hfr_submit_help: Submission sends the facility for verification. Until then the record is a draft.
abdm_hfr_submitted_next: The facility is submitted. When the registry issues the IN facility ID, the setup page shows it and the bridge linkage can run.
abdm_hfr_village_code: Village, city or town LGD code
abdm_hfr_wizard_intro: 5 calls in a fixed order: check for a duplicate, save the basic information (this creates the record), add the services, add the details, then submit. A record that is not submitted stays a draft and ABDM cannot use it.
abdm_hfr_wizard_title: Register the facility in the HFR
abdm_hint_aadhaar_help: Only used to send the OTP; Aadhaar is never stored.
abdm_hint_abha-address_help: Like name@abdm — the '@abdm' part can be left out.
abdm_hint_abha-number_help: Printed on the ABHA card. Dashes are optional.
abdm_hint_mobile_help: An OTP will be sent to this number by ABDM. If several ABHAs share it, you will pick one.
abdm_hint_mobile_label: Mobile number registered on the ABHA
abdm_hip_id_help: ABDM issues this ID when the HIP service is registered. It identifies this facility on every record-sharing request.
abdm_hip_id_pending: Assigned after the HIP service is registered
abdm_hip_name_help: What patients see in the PHR app. 15 characters or fewer, no special characters.
abdm_hip_name_invalid: HIP name must be 15 characters or fewer with no special characters.
abdm_hpid_create_intro: The registry opens an Aadhaar page in a new tab. Complete the Aadhaar OTP there; this page checks every 5 seconds. Then confirm your mobile number, choose a username and set a password.
abdm_hpid_finish_help: Choose your HPR username and password. The names come from Aadhaar; correct them only if the registry record must differ.
abdm_hpid_link_expired: The link has expired. Get a new one.
abdm_hpid_link_help: Open the Aadhaar page, enter your Aadhaar number there and verify the OTP. The link is valid for 5 minutes.
abdm_hpid_mobile_help: The registry compares the mobile number with Aadhaar. When it does not match, an OTP is sent to it.
abdm_hpid_no_url: The registry returned no link URL. This is a documented gap; press Check after you authenticate on the NHPR portal, or start again.
abdm_hpr_action_failed: The action could not be completed.
abdm_hpr_code_hint: A registry code. The docs example sends {{example}}.
abdm_hpr_documents_intro: The certificate slots the registry holds for you. Upload a file into a slot to replace it.
abdm_hpr_documents_need_session: Log in to the HPR to read the documents.
abdm_hpr_documents_none: The registry lists no document slot yet. Register the profile first.
abdm_hpr_facility_id_hint: The HFR ID of the facility you work at. The ABDM setup page of the facility shows it.
abdm_hpr_file_help: PDF, PNG or JPEG, up to 5 MB.
abdm_hpr_id_unknown: The registry holds no professional with this ID.
abdm_hpr_load_failed: Could not load your HPR state.
abdm_hpr_login_help: The registry names a mobile OTP for this HPR ID, but publishes no call to verify it. Use the password or an Aadhaar OTP.
abdm_hpr_login_intro: Your HPR ID and password never leave this server; the registry answers with a token the plug holds for you.
abdm_hpr_none_intro: Link the HPR ID you already have, or create one. Creation runs through an Aadhaar page of the registry; this system never sees your Aadhaar number.
abdm_hpr_otp_sent: An OTP was sent for {{id}} to {{mobile}}.
abdm_hpr_page_intro: Your identity as a healthcare professional or facility manager in ABDM. A facility manager's login is needed to register a facility in the HFR; a clinician's HPR ID names you on every consent request you raise.
abdm_hpr_professional_none: Press Read the registry to fetch it.
abdm_hpr_register_footer: The degree and registration certificates are mandatory; a proof of work is mandatory for government or both.
abdm_hpr_register_incomplete: Fill the first name, and 1 registration with its council, number and certificate.
abdm_hpr_register_intro: The HPR profile: personal details, address, contact, council registration with its certificate, qualifications with their certificates, and current work. Codes come from the registry's lists.
abdm_hpr_unlink_confirm: Unlink this HPR ID from your CARE account? The registry record is not changed.
abdm_hrp_register_failed: Could not register the HRP service.
abdm_link_abha_hint: Sign in with their ABHA card, ABHA address, mobile or Aadhaar.
abdm_link_step_accounts: Several ABHAs use this mobile number. Pick the patient's.
abdm_link_step_identify: Identify the patient with their ABHA card, address, mobile or Aadhaar.
abdm_link_step_otp: Enter the OTP sent by ABDM.
abdm_login_otp_aadhaar_mobile: Enter the OTP sent to the mobile linked with Aadhaar
abdm_login_otp_abha_mobile: Enter the OTP sent to the mobile registered on the ABHA
abdm_master_failed: The registry did not answer with this list. Try again later.
abdm_mobile_hint: Used for ABHA communication. If it differs from the Aadhaar-linked mobile, one more OTP is needed.
abdm_no_accounts: No ABHA is registered against this mobile number.
abdm_no_bridge_services: The gateway lists no service on this bridge yet. Register a facility's HIP service from its setup page.
abdm_no_counters: No counters yet. Add a counter code to get its QR code.
abdm_no_patient_for_abha: No patient with {{abha}} yet. Register them with the details from ABHA.
abdm_no_shared_profiles: No shared profiles in the last 24 hours.
abdm_not_linked_hint: This patient has no ABHA linked yet.
abdm_otp_system_abdm_hint: The number registered on the ABHA
abdm_qr_needs_hip_id: Set the HFR facility ID to get a QR code.
abdm_record_checksum_warning: The checksum the sending facility gave does not match this record. The content was decrypted and verified by the cipher; read it with care.
abdm_record_erased: The content of this record was erased when the permission ended.
abdm_registration_hint: Create or link the patient's health account; details are prefilled from ABDM.
abdm_save_before_register: Save the changes before you register.
abdm_section_scan_share_help: Print one QR code for each counter. A person scans it in the PHR app and shares the ABHA profile. Care answers with a token number.
abdm_share_qr_template_missing: The QR code URL format is not set. Set ABDM_SHARE_QR_URL_TEMPLATE on the server with the placeholders {hip_id} and {context}.
abdm_shared_profiles_help: Profiles that people shared at a counter QR code in the last 24 hours. Open the patient, or register a new patient with the shared details.
abdm_shared_profiles_load_failed: Could not load the shared profiles.
abdm_step_address: Step 3 of 3 — Choose an ABHA address
abdm_tab_intro: Records of this visit that the patient can find in an ABHA app. A record is shared only when you link it, or when the visit is completed.
abdm_tab_load_failed: Could not load the ABDM records of this visit.
abdm_tab_no_abha: The patient has no ABHA address. Link an ABHA on the patient page first.
abdm_tab_no_records: No shareable record yet. A prescription, a final diagnostic report or a discharge summary appears here when it is saved.
abdm_tab_records_closed_help: The visit is closed. Every staged record was queued for linking. A record added later stays staged until you link it.
abdm_tab_records_help: Select the records to share and press Link selected. When the visit is completed or discharged, every staged record is linked by itself.
abdm_tab_select_hint: Select 1 or more records to share.
abdm_will_link_on_save: Will be linked to the patient when you save.
abdm_nhpr_help_facility_name_what: The legal name of the facility. The registry publishes it, and patients see it.
abdm_nhpr_help_facility_name_how: Type the name as it is on the facility board. The service registration must send this exact name later.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_address_what: The street address the registry uses to find a possible duplicate.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_address_how: Type the street and the locality. Select the state and the district in their own fields.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_address_line1_what: The first line of the facility address in the registry record.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_address_line1_how: Type the building and the street. Do not repeat the district or the state here.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_address_line2_what: The second line of the address, for the locality or a landmark.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_address_line2_how: Type the locality or a landmark. Leave the field empty when line 1 is enough.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_board_photo_what: A photograph of the facility name board. The registry requires it.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_board_photo_how: Attach a PNG or JPEG file of 5 MB or less. CARE stores only the file name.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_building_photo_what: A photograph of the facility building. The registry requires it.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_building_photo_how: Attach a PNG or JPEG file of 5 MB or less. CARE stores only the file name.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_district_what: The district of the address, as a Local Government Directory (LGD) code.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_district_how: Select the state first. Then select the district. The registry accepts the code, not the name.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_email_what: The contact email address. The registry can send notices to it.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_email_how: Type a full address with an @ sign and a domain.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_facility_subtype_what: A finer class inside the facility type, from the registry master list.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_facility_subtype_how: Select the facility type first. Then select the subtype that fits best.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_facility_type_what: The class of the facility in the registry master list. It decides which detailed sections are mandatory.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_facility_type_how: Select 1 type. An inpatient or day-care type must report at least 1 bed in the detailed step.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_landline_what: The fixed-line telephone number of the facility.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_landline_how: Type the number without the STD code.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_latitude_what: The north-south position of the facility, in decimal degrees.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_latitude_how: Type a value between -90 and 90, in decimal degrees.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_longitude_what: The east-west position of the facility, in decimal degrees.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_longitude_how: Type a value between -180 and 180, in decimal degrees.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_mobile_what: The mobile number of the facility contact. The registry can send an OTP to it.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_operational_status_wh: Whether the facility is functional, from the registry master list.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_operational_status_ho: Select the status code. A functional facility uses code F.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_ownership_what: Who owns the facility: government, private, or a partnership. A registry code.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_ownership_how: Select 1 ownership. The 2 subtype fields depend on it.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_ownership_subtype_wha: A finer class of the ownership, from the registry master list.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_ownership_subtype_how: Select the ownership first. Then select the subtype.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_ownership_subtype2_wh: A second level under the ownership subtype, when the registry defines 1.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_ownership_subtype2_ho: Select the ownership subtype first. Leave the field empty when the list is empty.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_ownership_subtype2_ex: Example: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (MOHF).
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_pincode_what: The 6-digit postal code of the address.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_pincode_how: Type 6 digits. The first digit is not 0.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_region_what: Whether the address is urban or rural. It selects the list for the village or town field.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_region_how: Select U for urban or R for rural.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_source_of_information: Who supplied the details that you submit to the registry.
Type the source. Leave the field empty when the registry does not ask for it.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_speciality_type_what: Whether the facility offers 1 speciality or many.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_speciality_type_how: Select SINGLE or MULTI. The detailed step lists the specialities.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_state_what: The state of the address, as an LGD code. The registry accepts the code, not the name.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_state_how: Select the state. The district list follows the state.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_subdistrict_what: The taluk or sub-district of the address, as an LGD code.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_subdistrict_how: Select the district first. Then select the sub-district.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_system_of_medicine_wh: The systems the facility practises, as registry codes. More than 1 is allowed.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_system_of_medicine_ho: Tick each system that applies. Modern medicine is code M.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_system_of_medicine_ex: Example: M, D (modern medicine and dentistry).
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_type_of_service_what: Whether the facility gives inpatient care (IPD), outpatient care (OPD), or both.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_type_of_service_how: Tick IPD, OPD, or both. IPD requires bed counts in the detailed step.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_village_code_what: The village, city or town of the address, as an LGD code.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_village_code_how: Select the region and the sub-district first. Then select the place.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_website_what: The public website of the facility.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_website_how: Type the address without https://. Leave the field empty when there is none.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_lookup_label_what: The registry identifier of a facility. It starts with IN and has 12 characters.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_lookup_label_how: Type the full ID from the registry or from the facility certificate.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_facility_id_what: The HFR ID of the facility where the professional works.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_facility_id_how: Type the 12-character ID that starts with IN. Search the registry when you do not know it.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_hasDialysisCenter_wha: Whether the facility runs a dialysis centre.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_hasPharmacy_what: Whether the facility has a pharmacy. Y opens the pharmacy section in the detailed step.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_hasBloodBank_what: Whether the facility has a blood bank. Y opens the blood bank section in the detailed step.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_hasCathLab_what: Whether the facility has a cardiac catheterisation laboratory.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_hasDiagnosticLab_what: Whether the facility has a diagnostic laboratory.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_hasImagingCenter_what: Whether the facility has an imaging centre.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_nhrrId_what: The ID of the facility in the National Health Resource Repository.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_nhrrId_how: Type the ID when the facility holds 1. Leave the field empty otherwise.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_nin_what: The National Identification Number issued to health facilities.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_nin_how: Type the number when the facility holds 1. Leave the field empty otherwise.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_abpmjayId_what: The empanelment ID under Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_abpmjayId_how: Type the ID when the facility is empanelled. Leave the field empty otherwise.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_rohiniId_what: The ID in the Registry of Hospitals in the Network of Insurance.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_rohiniId_how: Type the ID when the facility holds 1. Leave the field empty otherwise.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_echsId_what: The empanelment ID under the Ex-Servicemen Contributory Health Scheme.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_echsId_how: Type the ID when the facility is empanelled. Leave the field empty otherwise.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_cghsId_what: The empanelment ID under the Central Government Health Scheme.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_cghsId_how: Type the ID when the facility is empanelled. Leave the field empty otherwise.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_ceaRegistration_what: The registration number under the Clinical Establishments Act.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_ceaRegistration_how: Type the number when the state issued 1. Leave the field empty otherwise.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_stateInsuranceSchemeI: The ID of the facility under the state health insurance scheme.
Type the ID when the facility holds 1. Leave the field empty otherwise.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_totalNumberOfBeds_wha: The total number of beds in the facility. An inpatient facility must report more than 0.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_totalNumberOfBeds_how: Type a whole number. Count every bed type once.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_countIPDBedsWithoutOx: Inpatient beds with no oxygen supply.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_countIPDBedsWithOxyge: Inpatient beds with an oxygen supply.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_countICUBedsWithVenti: Intensive care beds that have a ventilator.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_countICUBedsWithoutVe: Intensive care beds that have no ventilator.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_countHDUBedsWithVenti: High dependency unit beds that have a ventilator.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_countHDUBedsWithoutVe: High dependency unit beds that have no ventilator.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_totalNumberOfVentilat: The total number of ventilators in the facility.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_countDayCareBedsWitho: Day-care beds with no oxygen supply.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_countDayCareBedsWithO: Day-care beds with an oxygen supply.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_countDentalChairs_wha: The number of dental chairs in the facility.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_countDentalChairs_how: Type a whole number. Type 0 when there are none.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_isJanAushadhiKendra_w: Whether the pharmacy is a Pradhan Mantri Bhartiya Janaushadhi Kendra.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_isJanAushadhiKendra_h: Select Y or N. Y asks for the Kendra ID.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_janAushadhiKendraId_w: The ID of the Kendra issued by the scheme.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_janAushadhiKendraId_h: Type the ID when the pharmacy is a Kendra.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_drugLicenseNumber_wha: The licence number of the pharmacy under the Drugs and Cosmetics Act.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_drugLicenseNumber_how: Type the number as it is on the licence.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_pharmacyGstinNumber_w: The 15-character GST identification number of the pharmacy.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_pharmacistRegistratio: The state pharmacy council registration number of the pharmacist in charge.
Type the number as it is on the certificate.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_isFacilityRegisteredI: Whether the blood bank is registered in e-RaktKosh.
Select Y or N. Y asks for the e-RaktKosh ID.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_bloodStorageCenters_w: Whether the facility runs blood storage centres.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_bloodStorageCenters_h: Select Y or N. Y asks for the count.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_storageCentersCount_w: The number of blood storage centres the facility runs.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_eRaktoshId_what: The ID of the blood bank in e-RaktKosh.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_eRaktoshId_how: Type the ID as e-RaktKosh shows it.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_bloodBankLicenseNumbe: The licence number of the blood bank.
Type the number as it is on the licence.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_bloodCollectedPerAnnu: The number of blood units the bank collects in 1 year.
Type a whole number of units.
abdm_nhpr_help_hfr_bloodRequiredPerAnnum: The number of blood units the facility needs in 1 year.
Type a whole number of units.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpid_username_what: The readable part of the HPR address. The address becomes username@hpr.abdm.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpid_username_how: Pick 1 of the suggestions, or type your own. Use letters, digits and dots.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpid_password_what: The password for the new HPR ID. CARE encrypts it before it leaves the server.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpid_password_how: Type a strong password. The registry checks the strength.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpid_password_example: Example: A long phrase with digits.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpid_role_what: What the person is in the registry: a professional (1), a facility manager (2), or both (3).
abdm_nhpr_help_hpid_role_how: Select 2 or 3 when this person must register facilities.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpid_category_what: The professional category: doctor, nurse or pharmacist, from the registry master list.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpid_category_how: Select 1 category. The sub-category list follows it.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpid_subcategory_what: The system of medicine inside the category. The codes differ between the HPID and the profile calls, so pick from the list.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpid_subcategory_how: Select the category first. Then select the sub-category.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpid_first_name_what: The first name as it is on the Aadhaar record.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpid_first_name_how: Type the name exactly as Aadhaar shows it.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpid_middle_name_what: The middle name, when Aadhaar shows 1.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpid_middle_name_how: Type the name, or leave the field empty.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpid_last_name_what: The last name as it is on the Aadhaar record.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpid_last_name_how: Type the name exactly as Aadhaar shows it.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpr_id_what: Your identity in the professional registry, in 1 of 3 forms: the 14-digit number, the address, or the username.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpr_id_how: Type the number, the address, or the username. CARE adds @hpr.abdm to a username.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpr_password_what: The password of your HPR account. CARE sends it to the registry and does not store it.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpr_password_how: Type the password you set when the HPR ID was created.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpr_password_example: Example: The password from the HPR portal.
abdm_nhpr_help_otp_what: The 1-time code the registry sent to the mobile number linked to Aadhaar.
abdm_nhpr_help_otp_how: Type the 6 digits within the validity period. Ask for a new code when it expires.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpr_salutation_how: Select the title the registry lists.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpr_dob_what: The date of birth on the Aadhaar record.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpr_dob_how: Select the date. It must match Aadhaar.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpr_gender_what: The gender on the Aadhaar record.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpr_nationality_what: The nationality of the professional, as a registry code.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpr_nationality_how: Select the country from the list.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpr_languages_what: The languages the professional speaks, as registry codes.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpr_profile_photo_what: The photograph shown on the professional profile.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpr_profile_photo_how: Attach a PNG or JPEG file of 1 MB or less.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpr_official_mobile_what: The mobile number the registry uses to contact the professional.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpr_official_email_what: The email address the registry uses to contact the professional.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpr_public_mobile_what: A mobile number shown on the public profile, when the profile is public.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpr_public_mobile_how: Type a 10-digit number, or leave the field empty.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpr_public_email_what: An email address shown on the public profile, when the profile is public.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpr_public_email_how: Type a full address, or leave the field empty.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpr_visible_public_what: Whether the registry shows the profile in public search.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpr_visible_public_how: Select Yes to show the profile, or No to hide it.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpr_visible_photo_what: Whether the public profile shows the photo.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpr_father_what: The name of the father, as the registry asks for it.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpr_mother_what: The name of the mother, as the registry asks for it.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpr_spouse_what: The name of the spouse, when married.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpr_spouse_how: Type the full name, or leave the field empty.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpr_place_of_birth_state_: The state where the professional was born, as a registry code.
Select the state from the list.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpr_same_as_kyc_what: Whether the communication address equals the Aadhaar (KYC) address.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpr_same_as_kyc_how: Select Yes to reuse the KYC address. Select No to type another address.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpr_address_kyc_what: The address on the Aadhaar record. The registry fills it.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpr_address_kyc_how: Read it. Select No above when the current address differs.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpr_address_name_what: The name used at the communication address.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpr_address_name_how: Type the name on the door or the letter box.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpr_country_what: The country of the communication address, as a registry code.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpr_city_what: The city or town of the communication address.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpr_category_what: The professional category: doctor, nurse or pharmacist. It decides the registration and degree lists.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpr_type_what: The system of medicine sub-category. The degree code must agree with the category and this value.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpr_type_how: Select the category first. Then select the type.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpr_system_of_medicine_wh: The system of medicine of the registration.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpr_council_what: The council the professional is registered with, as a registry code.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpr_council_how: Select the council from the master list.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpr_registration_number_w: The number on the council registration certificate.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpr_registration_number_h: Type it as it is on the certificate.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpr_registration_date_wha: The date the council issued the registration.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpr_registration_date_how: Select the date on the certificate.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpr_permanent_what: Whether the registration is permanent or renewable.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpr_permanent_how: Select Permanent, or select Renewable and give the renewal due date.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpr_renewable_due_what: The date a renewable registration must be renewed.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpr_renewable_due_how: Select the date on the certificate.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpr_registration_category: The registry code for the registration category.
Select the value the master list offers for your council.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpr_registration_certific: A scan of the council registration certificate. The registry requires it.
Attach a PDF, PNG or JPEG file of 5 MB or less.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpr_name_differs_what: Whether the name on the certificate differs from the Aadhaar name.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpr_name_differs_how: Select Yes when it differs. Then attach the proof of the name change.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpr_name_change_proof_wha: A document that proves the change of name.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpr_name_change_proof_how: Attach a PDF, PNG or JPEG file of 5 MB or less.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpr_degree_what: The degree or diploma, as a registry course code. It must agree with the category and the type.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpr_degree_how: Select the degree from the master list.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpr_college_what: The college that taught the degree, as a registry code.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpr_college_how: Select the state first. Then select the college.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpr_university_what: The university that awarded the degree, as a registry code.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpr_university_how: Select the college first. The university follows it.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpr_university_example: Example: Kerala University of Health Sciences
abdm_nhpr_help_hpr_year_what: The year the degree was awarded.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpr_month_what: The month the degree was awarded.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpr_degree_certificate_wh: A scan of the degree certificate. The registry requires it.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpr_degree_certificate_ho: Attach a PDF, PNG or JPEG file of 5 MB or less.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpr_currently_working_how: Select Yes or No. No asks for the reason.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpr_reason_not_working_wh: Why the professional does not work now.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpr_reason_not_working_ho: Select the reason the registry lists.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpr_purpose_of_work_what: What the professional does: practice, teaching, research, or another purpose.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpr_work_status_what: Whether the work is government, private, or both. Government or both requires a proof of work.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpr_designation_what: The job title at the facility.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpr_department_what: The department the professional works in.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpr_ministry_what: The ministry a government facility belongs to.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpr_ministry_how: Select the ministry when the work status is government or both.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpr_ministry_example: Example: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
abdm_nhpr_help_hpr_proof_of_work_what: A document that proves the current job. The registry requires it for government work or both.
abdm_nhpr_help_hpr_proof_of_work_how: Attach a PDF, PNG or JPEG file of 5 MB or less.
abdm_hfr_linked_intro: This facility is linked to its registry record. The registered name below is what the bridge linkage sends. Set the HIP name, then register the ABDM services.
abdm_hfr_change_link_help: Find the correct registry record and link it. The HIP ID is forgotten when the registry facility changes. Register the services again after the change.
abdm_add_intro: Create a facility in CARE and connect it to ABDM in 1 guided flow. Choose how the facility relates to the Health Facility Registry, then follow the steps. You can close this page and come back: the progress is saved.
abdm_add_choose_help: Pick 1 option. The registry is the Health Facility Registry (HFR) of ABDM. A facility must be in it before it can share records.
abdm_add_mode_linked_help: Search the HFR and pick the record. CARE fills the facility details from it and links the 2 in 1 step.
abdm_add_mode_register_help: Create the facility in CARE, then register it in the HFR from here. You need an HPR ID with the facility manager role.
abdm_add_mode_care_help: Create the facility in CARE now. Connect it to ABDM later from its settings.
abdm_add_find_title: Find the facility in the registry
abdm_add_find_help: Look the facility up by its HFR ID, or search by name and state. Pick the record to continue.
abdm_add_details_help: Fill the CARE facility form. The government organization must go down to the lowest level.
abdm_add_details_help_linked: The fields marked "from the registry" came from the HFR record. Check them, then complete the rest.
abdm_add_already_linked: This registry record is already linked to {{name}}. Open that facility instead.
abdm_create_failed: CARE could not create the facility.
abdm_add_registry_title: Register the facility in the HFR
abdm_add_registry_help: 5 registry calls in a fixed order. Log in with a facility manager HPR ID first. The facility is in CARE already; the progress here is saved on it.
abdm_add_services_help: Register the facility as HIP and HIU on the bridge. The gateway then issues the HIP ID that every record share uses.
abdm_add_services_not_linked: The facility has no registry link yet. Register it in the HFR, or link it from its ABDM settings, then come back.
abdm_add_done_help: The facility exists in CARE and its ABDM state is below. Open the ABDM settings to add Scan and Share counters.
abdm_add_done_help_care: The facility exists in CARE. Connect it to ABDM later from its settings.
abdm_form_geo_prefilled: The state and the district were matched by name from the registry record. Pick the local body and the ward.
abdm_form_prefilled: From the registry record. Check it.
abdm_form_fix_fields: CARE refused some fields. Fix the marked fields and try again.
abdm_geo_help: Pick each level down to the lowest one. CARE files the facility under that organization.
abdm_geo_more: {{count}} organizations exist at this level; the first 200 are listed.
abdm_form_pincode_invalid: Type 6 digits; the first is not 0.
abdm_form_phone_invalid: Use the international format, for example +919876543210.
abdm_form_geo_invalid: Pick the government organization down to the lowest level.
abdm_admin_filter_facilities: Filter by name, HFR ID or HIP ID
abdm_hfr_search_help: The registry needs the state and the ownership for a name search. Type 3 or more letters of the name.
abdm_hpr_id_check_failed: The registry could not check this ID.
abdm_hfr_photos_required: Both photos are required for the first save. PNG or JPEG, 5 MB or less.
abdm_hfr_specialities_rule: The registry needs at least 1 speciality for every system of medicine chosen in the basic step.
abdm_hfr_specialities_missing: No speciality chosen for: {{codes}}. The registry refuses the step without them.
abdm_hfr_beds_zero_hint: An inpatient or day-care facility needs a total of 1 or more. A laboratory, imaging centre, blood bank or pharmacy can stay at 0.
abdm_dev_intro: Every call the plug made, every callback that answered, and every plug table. Secrets show as their kind and length, never their value.
abdm_dev_off_intro: The explorer opens to every logged-in user of this deployment when the setting below is true. A production deployment leaves it unset.
abdm_dev_off_how: Add the line to the Care environment (.env, prefix ABDM_), restart Care, then reload this page.
abdm_dev_load_failed: The explorer could not load this. Try again.
abdm_dev_no_exchanges: No exchange matches. Send a call from a patient or a facility page, then look here.
abdm_dev_more_rows: The newest {{count}} rows are shown. Narrow the filters to see older ones.
abdm_dev_no_callback_yet: No callback has arrived yet. The gateway posts it to the bridge URL; the worker handles it.
abdm_dev_sync_no_callback: A synchronous call: the answer is the HTTP body above.
abdm_dev_no_rows: This table has no row that matches.
abdm_dev_unknown_operation: path the plug does not know
abdm_dev_inbound_intro: Requests the gateway made of this deployment: discovery, link init and confirm, consent notify, health-information request, Scan and Share. Each with the acknowledgement the plug sent back.
abdm_dev_no_inbound: No inbound request yet. A PHR app discovery or a consent grant lands here.
abdm_dev_no_ack: No acknowledgement was sent. The gateway is waiting on this deployment.
abdm_dev_pick_table: Pick a table on the left.
abdm_dev_secret_columns: Secret columns shown as their length: {{columns}}
abdm_dev_readiness_intro: What is missing before a flow can work, named. A blocker stops a call before it is sent; a warning lets the call go and explains the silence that follows.
abdm_dev_response_async_hint: For a call, this HTTP answer is the gateway's acceptance only. The answer to the call arrives as a callback: see Callbacks.
